Definition: from a compound of G575 and G826; an off-flash, i.e. effulgence:--brightness.
BiblicalUsage: The brightness of God's glory — Christ is the radiance shining out from the Father, the exact imprint of his nature, upholding all things by his word of power. The word is a flash of light thrown off from its source, and it never leaves the source behind.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe this one picture settles who Jesus is: not a reflection at second hand, but God's own glory shining out in a person I can know.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
